description="start agetty on a terminal line"
supervisor=supervise-daemon
port="${RC_SVCNAME#*.}"
respawn_period="${respawn_period:-60}"
term_type="${term_type:-linux}"
command=/sbin/agetty
command_args_foreground="${agetty_options} ${port} ${baud} ${term_type}"
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"

depend() {
	after local
	keyword -prefix
	provide getty
}

start_pre() {
	if [ "$port" = "$RC_SVCNAME" ]; then
		eerror "${RC_SVCNAME} cannot be started directly. You must create"

		eerror "agetty on and add those to the appropriate runlevels."
		return 1
	else
		export EINFO_QUIET="${quiet:-yes}"
	fi
}

stop_pre()
{
	export EINFO_QUIET="${quiet:-yes}"
}

while ! rc-service inventory-worker status >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  [ "$attempt" -lt 20 ]
  sleep 1
done
supervisor_pid=$(cat /run/inventory-worker.pid)
worker_pid=$(cat "/proc/$supervisor_pid/task/$supervisor_pid/children" | awk '{print $1}')
worker_uid=$(awk '/^Uid:/{print $2}' "/proc/$worker_pid/status")
worker_gid=$(awk '/^Gid:/{print $2}' "/proc/$worker_pid/status")
worker_user=$(getent passwd "$worker_uid" | cut -d: -f1)
worker_group=$(getent group "$worker_gid" | cut -d: -f1)
[ "$worker_user" = inventory-worker ]
[ "$worker_group" = inventory-worker ]
rc-update show default | grep -F inventory-worker >/dev/null
kill -0 "$supervisor_pid"
kill -0 "$worker_pid"
printf 'old_boot_id=%s\nnew_boot_id=%s\nboot_identity_changed=yes\n' "$old_boot_id" "$new_boot_id"
printf 'post_restart_service=started enabled=default wait_attempts=%s\n' "$attempt"
printf 'post_restart_supervisor_pid=%s worker_pid=%s\n' "$supervisor_pid" "$worker_pid"
printf 'post_restart_worker_identity=%s:%s uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$worker_user" "$worker_group" "$worker_uid" "$worker_gid"
printf 'post_restart_worker_command='; tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$worker_pid/cmdline"; echo
printf 'post_restart_state_file='; stat -c 'present owner=%U:%G size=%s inode=%i' /var/tmp/os-comparison-flaky-worker-failed
printf '%s\n' '--- current-boot service log ---'
tail -40 /var/log/messages | grep -E 'inventory-worker|supervise-daemon' | tail -10
echo 'post_restart_health=healthy'
